intended_object: This is a helper that builds a bit string for the Turing-machine construction in the GapCVP reduction. It concatenates the payload words produced from four source maps. The docstring only says "GapCVP reduction support."
explanation: The definition joins `payload (first input)` with three `fiveForbiddenRawStrictPayloadWord` words, all of which are library-specific encoding pieces. It is internal machinery for a Turing-machine construction proof and has no standard mathematical counterpart in the literature. Its docstring and name give no mathematical object to compare it against.
